meta.title: I Answer All Your Wok Questions
meta.description:
Want to get your own questions into my next AMA? Join my Patreon and become a Frienji of Kenji!

You can get the full transcript of this video, watch it ad-free, and find links to join here: https://www.patreon.com/posts/152877467

If you want to help me write my next cookbook and see your name printed in it, join at the annual Cookbook Club level for even more recipes, livestreams, Q&As, and more.

Joining my Patreon, purchasing my books and products, and subscribing to my social media channels is the best way to support my work.

You can get any of my books (The Food Lab, The Wok and Every Night is Pizza Night) wherever books are sold, or you can order signed and personalized copies to be shipped anywhere in the world from here: https://booklarder.com/search?q=kenji

TIMESTAMPS
00:00 Intro
00:26 Carbon steel vs. titanium
08:40 Initial seasoning
12:13 Making it non-stick
14:46 Reseasoning with oil
16:27 Rusty woks
18:31 Induction cooking
22:05 Wok hei flavor
23:28 Sticky sides vs non-stick center
26:31 Induction temperature 
28:36 Wok rings
30:31 Which oil for cooking
31:43 Flat vs dome lids
32:59 Building up carbon
34:03 Tossing food wok-through
37:16 Order for adding food
42:42 Steamed vs. fried
43:39 Oily stir-fries
45:00 Outro

TOOLS & COOKWARE
Check out the wok I helped design with Our Place: https://fromourplace.com/products/carbon-steel-wok?utm_source=influencer&utm_medium=youtube&utm_campaign=kenji

https://www.kenjilopezalt.com/books
